title: Heavenly Sweet British Nectarine Trifle
description: A sweet and crumbly British dessert featuring nectarines, perfect for midnight cravings, and friendly to all diets, including Buddhist temple standards, served in a beautiful lacquerware bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the diced nectarines, tagine spice mix, and honey until well combined.
Pour the almond milk into the bowl and stir until the nectarines are fully coated.
Transfer the nectarine mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
While the nectarines are baking, crush the oat biscuits in a separate bowl.
In a large lacquerware bowl, create a layer of crushed oat biscuits.
Once the nectarines are done baking, let them cool and then add them on top of the oat biscuit layer.
Spread a layer of whipped cream over the nectarines.
Sprinkle shredded coconut and chopped almonds over the whipped cream.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of whipped cream on top.
